newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa co-op Sentraal Wes privatisation delayed.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa co-op Sentraal Wes privatisation delayed.

text.p: Plans by South African agricultural co-op, Sentraal Wes, to restructure into a private company by the end of the year have been delayed due to opposition from a group of its members, the organisation said.
Sentraal Wes said in a statement on Thursday 10 members had opposed the privatisation move in court stating as a reason for their action irregularities in the co-op's financial accounts.
The court case has been postponed until February 18.
Sentraal Wes said the opposing group was not representative of the co-op's members, 98 percent of which supported privatisation.
